_comment: SYNTHETIC demo postings written for CoopCompass development. Companies are fictional. These are NOT real openings and must never be presented as such.

jobs.title: Data Analyst Co-op
jobs.description:
About the role
Join our analytics team for a 6-month co-op.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau and Power BI for product and operations leaders
- Write SQL queries to analyze product usage data and answer ad-hoc business questions
- Automate recurring reports using Python and Pandas
- Present insights to non-technical stakeholders

Requirements
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in analytics, statistics, engineering or a related field
- Proficiency in SQL and Python
- Experience building dashboards in Tableau or Power BI
- Strong communication skills

Preferred
- Familiarity with A/B testing
- Exposure to AWS or Azure

Salary: $28 - $34 per hour. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States.
